Finding the right driver should not mean searching a huge pool by hand.

Bus operations supervisors and duty allocators must cover open work while comparing availability, roster lines, rest patterns and two drivers’ hours regimes. In an ageing allocation workflow, the search becomes slow, difficult to evidence and vulnerable to incorrect time coding.

“I need to find a driver who can cover the duty, confirm which rules apply, and understand why the allocation can or cannot proceed.”Invented quote based on the identified operational need.

Who RuleReady is for

Daily user

Bus operations supervisors and duty allocators covering open work.

Decision-maker

An operations or compliance manager responsible for allocation controls and audit evidence.

Core value

Separate the 90-minute incentive from actual activity and make EU561 and Domestic decisions explainable.

Requirements

Identify the correct ruleset.
Display roster lines and rest patterns.
Show only initially qualifying drivers.
Calculate workdays, rest and entered hours.
Separate incentive payment from actual activity.
Explain and record each decision.

How it works

1. Select

Choose a fictional open duty.

2. Review

See qualifying sample drivers and the roster position.

3. Decide

Enter verified hours, review the result and sign off.

External user test

A tester with no experience of bus operations used the duty board, qualifying-driver list, roster lines and checker. Early allocations were incorrect while the workflow was being learned. After following the flags and repeating the sequence, the tester successfully allocated several duties and created a record.

Change made: a numbered guide was added so the relationship between duty, qualifying driver, roster line and checker is clear.
